serverInfo.name: bizfile-mcp
serverInfo.description: Every agentic payment workflow built on Stripe MPP, Alipay AI Pay, or Shopify UCP has a moment where the agent must authorise a transfer without being able to reason its way to a reliable counterparty assessment. This server answers that question in two calls -- returning a machine-readable PROCEED / ENHANCED_DUE_DILIGENCE / BLOCK verdict so the agent can act immediately. Used before any payment rail invocation.
